summary: Analyze public spending with PEFA, COFOG, and practical review tools. Build budget evidence and reporting skills. Explore the 5-day course.
lede: Public expenditure review training helps public finance analysts, budget officers, and sector specialists assess how public resources are allocated and used. Participants apply PEFA evidence, classify spending with COFOG, compare budgets with outturns, and examine efficiency and distribution using fiscal and service-delivery data. They also practice spreadsheet data checks and plan a review report and dashboard to communicate findings.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who analyze, manage, or use public expenditure evidence to prepare budgets, review service spending, and advise decision-makers.
modules: IMF GFS and COFOG Data Analysis
prerequisites: Prior work exposure to public budgeting, public financial management, or expenditure data is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheet functions is useful for the Excel-based analysis exercises.
